title: Degradation of antibiotic fosfomycin by peroxymonosulfate/ferrate and simultaneous phosphate removal with in situ formed ferric nanoparticles
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,296-307
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00701A, Paper
Wen Jiang, Wenhao Lao, Zhe Xu, Yiping Feng, Jiuli Ruan
Fe(VI)/PMS achieves complete fosfomycin degradation via synergistic radical/high-valent iron oxidation, and the in situ formed ferric nanoparticles enable simultaneous phosphate removal through co-precipitation.
